description: Step 1 of AI 3D generation on the user's connected PrintPal account. Validates the prompt or attached image, quality and format, and returns the exact credit cost, the account's available credits, normalised settings and a short-lived quote_token. Nothing is generated or charged. Show the user the cost and settings, then call generate_3d_model only if they agree. Text: pass `prompt`. Image-to-3D: pass the attached image as `image` (prompt is then an optional label). default (the standard setting, 256³), high (384³) and ultra (512³) accept text or an image and export stl/glb/obj/ply. super / superplus / superplus_1280 / superplus_1536 are high-resolution tiers (stl/glb/obj/fbx); their *_texture variants add colour textures and export glb or obj (obj arrives as a zip). High-resolution tiers work best from an image. prepare_3d_generation returns the exact credit cost.

image.description: An image the user attached in the conversation (PNG, JPEG or WebP).

download_url.description: Temporary download URL supplied by the host.

image_url.description: For clients without file attachments: an https URL of a PNG/JPEG/WebP image.

prompt.description: What to generate, e.g. "low-poly seated fox figurine". Required without an image.

name: prepare_3d_generation
title: Price an AI 3D generation
